uncited: All methods in this family optimize a set of $N$ 3D Gaussian primitives [3761-3d-gaussian-splatting-training.md].
The optimization minimizes a loss function $\mathcal{L}$ between rendered images and ground truth views, typically using the Adam optimizer [3761-3d-gaussian-splatting-training.md].
The rendering process involves projecting 3D Gaussians to 2D screen space, sorting by depth, and alpha blending [3761-3d-gaussian-splatting-training.md].
The optimization of 3D Gaussian Splatting was introduced alongside the original 3DGS method [3761-3d-gaussian-splatting-training.md].
It builds on [3D Gaussian Splatting](2812-3d-gaussian-splatting.md) by providing the differentiable training loop necessary to learn scene parameters from 2D observations.
